product.name: Shared Board
product.oneSentence: Let a person and an agent inspect and add items to the same revisioned board.
audience: People collaborating with an agent in an open page
product.sharedArtifact: A visible revisioned board persisted in browser storage.

humanWorkflow.entrypoint: Open the board and use the labelled add-item form.
humanWorkflow.visibleFeedback: The item list, count, revision, and activity record update from the canonical board store.

capabilities.userJourney: Inspect the complete current board before deciding what to add.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Read the board list, count, and revision.

resultContract.summary: Return board identity, all current items, item count, and revision.

successEvidence: The returned item count and revision match the visible board.

capabilities.userJourney: Add one item without overwriting a newer human or agent edit.

ui.visibleEffect: The board list, count, revision, and activity record display the committed item.

resultContract.summary: Return board identity, the added item, item count, and committed revision.

successEvidence: The returned item appears in the visible list.
The returned revision matches the visible revision.
